title: Text API errors got clearer
summary:
A spring-cleaning day for the text and image backends: clearer errors, tidier request handling, and more tests.

The text API now returns structured JSON errors, rejects empty message arrays with a 400 response, and handles missing query parameters. Invalid-message errors no longer echo submitted values.

Image referrer detection recognizes more header spellings. Related changes tightened how rate limiting and queue delays apply to requests, without establishing a change to the configured request limit.

A new workflow runs affected text or image backend tests on pull requests. The text service also gained more tests and coverage tooling, moved logs to debug namespaces, and removed unused provider code and qwen-coder from its available model list.
